_comment.purpose: Canonical workflow-state JSON schema. Dual-written alongside workflow-state.md on every phase transition. workflow-state.md is always authoritative; this file is derived from it and repaired toward it on any mismatch (see workflow-manager's 'workflow-state.md Vs workflow-state.json Conflict Resolution').
_comment.feature_slug: Stable identifier for the feature folder, matches spec/<feature_slug>/ directory name.
_comment.current_phase: Primary continuation pointer; mirrors workflow-state.md 'Current Phase' (Requirements | Design | Implementation | Complete). 'Implementation' means Design Spec handoff to agent-tdd has been made — this plugin tracks no finer-grained implementation-stage state.
_comment.phase_state: Mirrors workflow-state.md 'Workflow Status' (In Progress | Blocked | Awaiting Confirmation | Awaiting Implementation Request | Complete).
_comment.auto_advance: Whether the workflow should proceed to the next phase automatically without explicit user re-approval (Yes | No), mirrors recap.md Auto-Advance.
_comment.pause_reason: Mirrors workflow-state.md 'Pause Reason'; must align with any unresolved blocker or confirmation checkpoint in the phase artifacts.
_comment.blocked_fields: List of specific field names or sections currently blocked/awaiting confirmation, so a rewind or resume can target exactly what is unresolved.
_comment.implementation_requested: Mirrors workflow-state.md 'Implementation Requested' (Yes | No); gates whether the agent-tdd handoff may begin.
_comment.last_updated: ISO 8601 date/time of the most recent write to this file, mirrors workflow-state.md 'Last Updated' semantics.
_comment.last_transition_actor: Which actor performed the most recent phase transition (User | Spec Driven Development | Workflow Manager | UX Agent), extends workflow-state.md 'Current Owner' with transition-specific attribution.
_comment.recap_path: Relative path to this feature's recap.md file, so hooks and skills can locate it without recomputing the path.
_comment.hook_history: Append-only array of past hook invocations (hook name, outcome, decision, timestamp), extends workflow-state.md's single 'Last Hook Run/Outcome/Decision' fields with full history for repair and audit.
_comment.agent_nelly_available: Cached boolean result of the agent-types-listing Availability Check (see workflow-manager 'Availability Check'), refreshed at the before-requirements and before-continue hooks; missing means not yet checked, not an error.
_comment.intent_hash: SHA256 hash of intent.md content at workflow start; used for Intent drift detection. Mirrors workflow-state.md 'Intent Hash'.
_comment.intent_alignment_status: Intent alignment status: aligned | drift | unreviewed. Mirrors workflow-state.md 'Intent Alignment Status'.
_comment.nelly_brief_cache: Optional persistent cache of agent-nelly orchestrator brief (PHASE 1 feature). Object with {brief_text, fetched_at, intent_hash, valid} for reuse on resume.
_comment.research_cache: Optional persistent cache of planning-agent findings (PHASE 2 feature). Object with {path, generated_at, intent_hash, file_hashes, valid} to skip re-research.
_comment.rollback_pending: Additive, optional field (see INTEROP.md's '<- agent-tdd / code-reviewer (rollback request)' section and workflow-manager's 'Rollback Request Intake'). Object with target/reason/source when a mid-implementation rollback request has been recognized but not yet acted on; absent means no pending rollback -- same 'missing = not yet checked/applicable' precedent as agent_nelly_available. Written by hooks/subagent_report.py, read and cleared by workflow-manager's before-continue hook.

phase_state: <In Progress | Blocked | Awaiting Confirmation | Awaiting Implementation Request | Complete>
pause_reason: <None | blocker | confirmation required | waiting for implementation request>
last_transition_actor: <User | Spec Driven Development | Workflow Manager | UX Agent>
intent_hash: <SHA256 hash of intent.md, for drift detection>
